clues.text: Casting a net into the Sea of Galilee, this fisherman was called by Jesus along with his brother.
He was one of two disciples who heard John the Baptist's testimony about Jesus, then followed Jesus.
After spending a day with Jesus, he first found his own brother, saying, 'We have found the Messiah.'
When Jesus asked how to feed a huge crowd, this disciple pointed out a boy who had five barley loaves.
Some Greeks at the feast wanted to see Jesus, so Philip passed their request on to this disciple.
He came from Bethsaida in Galilee, the same town as the disciple Philip.
Sitting on the Mount of Olives across from the temple, he was one of four disciples who privately asked Jesus about its fall.
